mapping.name: Firefox History
mapping.description: Each row represents a Firefox page visit, with URL, title, visit time, visit count, referrer, and hidden state where available. Use it to reconstruct navigation and correlate browsing with downloads, credentials, or endpoint events. History can be incomplete because of deletion, private browsing, retention, synchronization, or profile selection.
mapping.short_description: Shows Firefox URL visits with titles, timestamps, visit counts, referrers, and hidden status.
mapping.query: SELECT moz_places.url, moz_places.title, moz_historyvisits.visit_date/1000 as visit_date_ms, moz_places.visit_count, referer.url as referer, moz_places.hidden FROM moz_places LEFT JOIN moz_historyvisits ON moz_places.id = moz_historyvisits.place_id LEFT JOIN moz_historyvisits AS referring_visit ON moz_historyvisits.from_visit = referring_visit.id LEFT JOIN moz_places AS referer ON referring_visit.place_id = referer.id WHERE visit_date_ms is not null

field.description: Timestamp when the page was visited
Number of times the page has been visited
URL of the referring page, if any
Flag indicating whether the entry is hidden from history (1 = hidden)
